OUR STORY

From NISE to NISE COMPORT

We began as NISE in 1995, a small computer and digital-services desk for our neighbourhood in Kharangajhar, Telco. People came for a print-out or a form, and stayed because someone patiently explained what to do next.

Over the years that grew into NISE COMPORT: a CSC / Pragya Kendra service centre where families, students, shopkeepers and senior citizens find PAN and Aadhaar help, Jharkhand certificates, banking and AEPS, insurance, online forms, printing, and computer sales and repair, all in one place.

“We have made our way from NISE to NISE COMPORT because of you. We have never forgotten our ethic: serve every person honestly, at the best price available today.”

We look forward to continuing to serve our community, and to adding more services that help it grow.

HOW WE WORK

Simple, from the first question

  1. 1

    Tell us what you need

    Walk in, call, WhatsApp or send a request online. We explain the route, the documents and the charges first.

  2. 2

    We prepare it with you

    We check documents, fill the forms and let you review every detail before anything is submitted.

  3. 3

    We submit and follow up

    We submit on the official portal, give you the acknowledgement and tell you where to track it.

  4. 4

    Clear charges, clear receipt

    Our service charge is shown separately from government or portal fees, and you get a receipt.

Honest service, fair price

The same ethic we started with in 1995: serve every person honestly, at the best price available in the market.

Your documents stay private

Files are kept privately, used only for your request and deleted on schedule. Staff never ask for your OTP or PIN.

Real people, in person

A friendly desk you can walk up to, in Hindi or English, with the same faces you saw last time.
